description:
Good American Cofounder and CEO Emma Grede sat down with Forbes to discuss her new book, 'Start With Yourself', and her framework for self-leadership in business. Grede talks about the necessity of destigmatizing money conversations among women and the importance of holding a concrete vision rather than relying on manifestation. She also details her "rule of thirds" for contextualizing the difficulties of entrepreneurship and explored how agentic AI will transform small businesses.

author: Forbes
description:
At 29, London-based designer Sinead Gorey didn’t set out to build a fashion brand, she just knew she didn’t want to work for someone else.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
After her graduate collection caught the attention of the British Fashion Council, she was invited to show at Fashion Week—leading to an ASOS deal that funded her first collection.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Now, her label, worn by artists like Sabrina Carpenter and Lady Gaga, is building a new kind of contemporary fashion brand from the ground up.
title: How Sinead Gorey Built A Fashion Brand From A Graduate Collection

author: Forbes
description:
From fixing payments at Revolut to rethinking how we pay, Maria Martí Garcia isn’t just building fintech, she’s rebuilding it.⁣
⁣
Before Five ID, she kept seeing the same problem: even as tech improved, fees from legacy players kept rising.⁣
⁣
Now, she’s turning your palm into your wallet, cutting checkout times and removing the middleman entirely.
title: This Founder Is Replacing Your Wallet With Your Hand

author: Forbes
description:
Replit Cofounder and CEO Amjad Masad sat down with Forbes to discuss the evolution of "vibe coding" and how AI is automating the software creation process. Masad discusses the origins of Replit, which helped make him a billionaire, the launch of Agent 4 and the Replit Canvas, which allows users to collaborate with AI using a digital whiteboard interface. Additionally, he shared insights into his personal journey as an immigrant from Jordan, his views on the Palestinian struggle, and Replit’s strategic plans for international expansion into markets like Saudi Arabia, India, and Japan
